hotspots.name: The Coal Chute
hotspots.description: A hatch onto the yard, wide enough for a man who did not mind the state of his coat. It is bolted. From this side.

hotspots.name: Behind the Crates
hotspots.description: A gap between the crates and the wall, just wide enough to sit in. The coal dust on the flagstones here has been disturbed and then carefully smoothed over.

hotspots.name: The Coal Heap
hotspots.description: Half a ton of Ashfen's finest, which is to say the sort that burns wet. Nothing is buried in it. You check anyway, and your cuffs will not forgive you.
